Computational Content Analysis

Lecture, nov 24

  • Quantitative content analysis (Neuendorf 2017)
    • manifest content features, descriptive
    • latent content, inference
  • Natural language processing (Vasiliev 2020)
    • lexical analysis, frequencies,
    • topic modelling, corpus exploration
    • text categorization, e.g. spam mail
    • sentiment analysis
    • text embeddings
  • Computer vision (Niebles & Krishna 2017)
